member.name: T:Microsoft.VisualBasic.MachineLearning.CNN.CNNLayerArguments
member.summary: The "layer specification": a deferred description of a layer that has not been created yet.

remarks.para: This type exists to support the fluent network building style: the factory functions in produce specification objects and the + operator instantiates and appends them at the right time:
remarks.code: Dim cnn As LayerBuilder = New LayerBuilder() + input_layer({28, 28}, 1) + conv_layer(5, 32, 1, 2) + pool_layer(2, 2, 0) + relu_layer() + full_connected_layer(10) + softmax_layer()
remarks.para: Deferred creation is necessary because a layer needs the of the previous layer at construction time (to derive its own input size), and that object is internal state of the which cannot be referenced before the chained expression has been evaluated.

Unlike the same named type in the R# MLkit (studio\Rsharp_kit\MLkit\MachineLearning\CNNLayerArguments.vb), which carries parameters through a type string and an args dictionary for weakly typed scripting, this VB version uses a delegate and is therefore type safe: the parameters are captured at compile time and there is no runtime "unknown layer type" branch.

member.name: T:Microsoft.VisualBasic.MachineLearning.CNN.CNNLayers
member.summary: Factory functions for building the layer specifications of a CNN network.

remarks.para: The function names correspond one to one with the MLkit of R# (studio\Rsharp_kit\MLkit\MachineLearning\CNN.vb), so a network definition written in an R# script can be translated line by line into VB. Taking tutorials\..\CNN_image\auto_encoder.R as an example:
remarks.code:
' R#: let cnn = cnn() + input_layer([28, 28], 1) + conv_layer(5, 32, 1, 2) + pool_layer(2, 2, 0) + leaky_relu_layer() + softmax_layer();
' VB: Dim cnn = New LayerBuilder() + input_layer({28, 28}, 1) + conv_layer(5, 32, 1, 2) + pool_layer(2, 2, 0) + leaky_relu_layer() + softmax_layer()
remarks.para: The only difference is that VB requires the binary operator at the end of the previous line for an implicit line continuation, whereas R# allows it at the start of the next line.

These functions all return objects (layers that have not been created yet). The + operator instantiates them from left to right, so the resulting layer sequence is identical to calling buildXxxLayer for every layer individually.

member.summary: 把后端算出的 (KH, KW, C, OutC) 卷积核梯度**累加**回各个 (d) 的 dw。
member.remarks: 这里必须累加而不是直接赋值: 参数梯度是在一个 mini-batch 之内跨样本累加的 (``TrainerAlgorithm.train`` 每 ``batch_size`` 个样本才调用一次 ``adjustWeights``, 且只有在那里才把 ``g(j)`` 清零), 如果直接赋值就会丢掉同一批内前面样本的贡献, 等效学习率被缩小 batch_size 倍。
